People don’t realize that these “wildlife parks” are started up so that people can get the permits to legally own these exotics as pets, and they’ll often use them for profit to have access to more exotics. It’s not a zoo, it’s one persons desire to own tigers and lions and bears as pets and treat them as such, and the messages it sends are incredibly dangerous. Not only that, but NO ethical zoo would ever sell a tiger this young to another zoo, and no ethical zoo would buy a tiger this young from another zoo.  TWP is an unethical facility doing and promoting dangerous things with animals and unfortunately these types of places get a lot of support because the general public wants to play with animals and see cute animal content.
